website_metadata.notes: American Express Banking Corp India publishes only an INSTITUTIONAL term-deposit rate card (min deposit Rs 15 Lakh; accepts deposits only from Companies, Partnerships, Trusts, Associations, Societies, Clubs, NGOs; explicitly NOT individuals or HUFs). No retail FD product. Institutional rate-card PDF at americanexpress.com/content/dam/amex/in/legal/notice-board/Ratecard/RateCard_Jan..pdf (w.e.f. 30 Jan 2020) is a T&C sheet whose per-tenure grid is image-rendered / absent in text; WebFetch returns HTTP 403. Re-verified: web search returns only US AmEx CD products and aggregators.

warnings: No retail/individual FD product; deposits institutional-only (>= Rs 15 Lakh).
